$50,000 ([[America's Favorite Houseguest|Fan Favorite]]) |InstagramUserName = tsdeslauriers |theamazingrace={{otherfandom|amazingrace|Tucker_&_Eric}} }}'''Tucker Schall Des Lauriers''' was a houseguest on ''[[Big Brother 26 (US)]]''. Tucker began the game with little initial threat level, forming early connections with [[Joseph Rodriguez]] and [[Kimo Apaka]] and a showmance with [[Rubina Bernabe]], while also developing a one-sided rivalry with [[Lisa Weintraub]] that contributed to her eviction. Known for frequently volunteering as a pawn, he repeatedly put his own game at risk, including during [[Quinn Martin|Quinn Martin's]] Deepfake HOH week when he won veto but, misunderstanding [[Cedric Hodges|Cedric Hodges’]] guidance, chose to save [[Angela Murray]] and helped shift the week’s nominations, escalating tensions with Cedric and Quinn. Despite several competition wins that kept him afloat, Tucker’s chaotic gameplay and self-nomination strategy made him a growing liability within the house. When ally [[T'kor Clottey]] became HOH, he was nominated as a pawn and, unable to win veto or AI Arena, was ultimately evicted in a 5-3 vote as the house took the opportunity to eliminate the volatile threat.
